1933, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 148 Oct. 3rd. John Millon - 40 - Wife & daughter beg your prayers - in Rec. Hospital.
Oct. 3rd. On Sept. 5th Bernard Geise, fatily injured at 3:30a.m. and become a raving maniac was enrolled in S.M.A. and is reported to have changed instantly, so that they took off the chains that bound him. He died peacefully next day.
4 Mary J. Langell - 19 mo. - born to parents after 11 years pleading to God for a baby. Had bronchitis and intestinal "flu" last Novem- ber. She was enrolled at 4 P.M ..... found to have gone to sleep at time of enrollment. Now perfect ....
Michael Jasczowski - 51 - lost memory - Dr's & family have not much hopes.
Mrs. Ann McCarthy - 41 - Tumor feared
Lorene Dype - 37 - tumor on Brain.
4 Peter Flanagan - 53 - prayed for Sept. 19 - had tumor or ....? on lungs - was hopeless. Perfectly O.K. now. Deo Gr. - had promised weekly Communion for a year.
Page 149 Oct. 5th Mrs. Pene. Buss - 58 - Presbiterian, good, earnest woman, but for yrs seems at times just like bewitched .... "Enrolled" To-day - 50¢ Mrs. Evons - 36 - threatened cancer, in terrible pains since March. C. Pomerville - 35 - Asthma trying to help sick mother. 7th Sr. Monica - 50 - St. Josephs SSrs of London Ont. - high blood pres- sure .....
Mrs. Frankovick - 71 - grippe - never sick before. · John Calciterra - 42 - short of breath - nervous .. Mrs. Lillian Daniec - 38 - inward cancer - has four small children. Rose M. Cowen - 45 - sinus & intestinal - St. Jos. Retreat - C 1 Carmine Mirante - 55 - 3 yrs. out of work.
Page 150 Oct. 8th. Charles J. Eyerman enrolled % telegram from Covington, Ky .... "Critically ill .... "
